summary: CrewFit Intelligence Assessment™ Phase 1 fully verified. 18/18 pytest cases pass in 175s against live backend (real Claude Sonnet 4.5 calls, no mocking). Adaptive interview walked 24 questions before AI signalled should_end=true; DNA synthesised with all 25 required fields; ai_confidence_score in-range; event_builder answer materialised into db.events with source='assessment_v1'; onboarded flag flipped; idempotent finalize; PATCH validation + filtering; full auth gating on all 7 endpoints.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD ('reserved name'). Tests must use example.com or a real-looking TLD. Not a defect but worth documenting.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 4789 lines is well beyond the 700-line guideline — should be split into modules (assessment, reality, roster, workouts, coach, auth). Not new to this iteration but flagged again.
POST /api/assessment/finalize accepts body as raw dict rather than a Pydantic model — consider a AssessmentFinalizeBody(BaseModel) for consistency with other endpoints and better validation.

_assessment_next_question passes transcript json truncated to 8500 chars — sufficient for a 25-question interview but hard-coded slice could silently drop context on longer runs. Consider size-aware chunking or a token-based cap.

In assessment_finalize event materialisation, dedupe is only by (user_id, event_date); two events on the same date (e.g. wedding + medical) would be collapsed to one silently. Consider also matching on event_name/type.

PATCH /coaching-dna silently drops unknown fields — good for defence-in-depth but no signal in the response indicating what was ignored. Optional improvement: include 'ignored_fields' in the response.
seed_data_creation: One fresh test client user is created per test module via /api/auth/signup with unique test_assessment_<hex>@example.com. All docs (user, assessments, coaching_dna, dna_history, events) are torn down in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_assessment_engine.py. Each full run costs ~3 minutes because Claude generates every interview question and the final DNA synthesis in real time. Interview walked 24 questions and covered 6 different question types (single_select, multi_select, long_text, short_text, number, event_builder). Emails using the '.test' TLD are rejected by Pydantic EmailStr — use example.com. Fixture auto-cleans users/assessments/dna/events on teardown so it's safe to rerun without pollution.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial signup 422 during test run 1 was due to pydantic's email-validator rejecting the '.test' reserved TLD; fixed test to use @example.com and all 18 cases passed.
